Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Rock Hudson death and AIDS federal funding 2. Diane McGrath wants to close all gay sex establishments and start mandatory HTLVIII tests for health and food employees 3. Jerry Falwell loses court battle, must pay 5,000 dollars to gay activist Jerry Sloan 4. Two prominent West German public officials come out of the closet COMMERCIAL: Orientation '85, funded by The National Gay Task Force 5. The future of New York's gay rights bill 6. Barry Gingell, New York City physician, discusses smuggling illegal AIDS drugs from Mexico 7. AIDS treatment around the world 8. Princess Diana fires "confirmed bachelors" due to sexual orientation COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 9. Sports, includes clip 10. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Ken Wein, psychotherapist, discusses how to cope with AIDS anxiety 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Sybil Bruncheon COMMERCIAL: GMHC Healthy Sex Workshops 2. Sybil Bruncheon reads letters COMMERCIAL: Orientation '85, funded by The National Gay Task Force 3. Sybil Bruncheon closes COMMERCIAL: AIDS hotline, New York AIDS Action 4. Broadway Confidential, includes clip from "Golden Girls" 5. Current events/media/culture, includes clip from "Hotel"
